question.prompt: The distance from point \(A\) to line \(l\) is 3.5 cm. Point \(A'\) is the reflection of \(A\) across \(l\). What is the length of \(AA'\)? (Unit: cm)

solutions.explanation: \(A\) and \(A'\) are equally distant from \(l\), and the segment joining them is perpendicular to \(l\). Thus, \(AA'=3.5\times2=7\).
solutions.title: Double the distance to the axis
